name: Marked-Edge Peeling Profile
definition: For an ample family $A$ with ordered marked edge $D=\{u,v\}$ of direction $e$, the five Boolean entries quantify over acyclic unique-sink orientations. The retention entry $r_D$ is one when some out-map satisfies $r(u),r(v)\subseteq\{e\}$. The sink entry $t_s$ is one when some out-map has $r(s)=\varnothing$. The leaf-exit entry $\ell_s$ is one when some out-map has $r(s)=\{e\}$. Equivalently, these mean respectively peeling to $D$, peeling to $s$, and a complete peeling in which $s$ is the first endpoint deleted and is then a leaf adjacent to the other endpoint.
parameters: An ordered marked edge $D=(u,v)$; reversing its order swaps the two sink entries and the two leaf-exit entries.
normalization: The common edge direction is denoted $e$ and the entries record existence, not a chosen orientation.
comments: The profile is invariant under isomorphisms preserving the ordered marked edge. Intrinsic structural tests for which profiles are attainable remain open in the manuscript.
